horizon_support.Last 30 Days: not supported by source data (UI interpolates)
horizon_support.Year to Date: not supported by source data (UI interpolates)

geography.detail: No coordinates in source data; map positions are schematic.

scenario.detail: No adjustable inputs or scenario parameters.

text.detail: One insight per frontend node only; no review/feedback text.

underrepresented_areas: Time: only 5-7 consecutive days; no weekly cycle, month or year coverage.
Backend rows have no facility, so facility comparison exists only in the frontend source.
Critical cases are rare: 1 frontend node and ~3 backend shift-days.
sampling_bias: Source is the whole synthetic population, so there is no sampling bias against it (nothing was dropped).
Population bias: the population itself is hand-authored (frontend) or uniform-random (backend) and does not represent real operations.
Frontend facility/team values were authored to tell a story (e.g. night shift critical); effects found later are designed, not discovered.
scope_of_result: PASS applies to the 7-day comparative view of 2 facilities x 3 teams. It does NOT cover 30-day or year-to-date horizons.
